# [\#11 Issue](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/11) `closed`: Add API endpoints

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) opened issue at [2026-05-24 00:25](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/11):

The API endpoints are grouped based on the two _MongoDB Collections_:

1. `Users` To store account and user information
2. `Trips` To store trip information

#### _Users_
- [x] **GET** `/api/users/profile`
_Returns_: User profile page for the logged in user. If no user is logged in, an HTTP 401 "Unauthorized" message is returned.

- [x] **GET** `/api/users/trips` - 
_Returns_: Saved user trip history for the logged in user. If no user is logged in, an HTTP 401 "Unauthorized" message is returned.

- [x] **GET** `/api/users/trips/filter` - 
_Data Sent_: Search parameters sent as query parameters to allow for query filtering of the logged in user's trip data. If no user is logged in, an HTTP 401 "Unauthorized" message is returned.
_Data Validated_: No because data is only being retrieved from the database. Will need to handle situation where search parameters don't make sense.
_Data Returned_: Trip data in the form of JSON data.

- [x] **POST** `/api/users/create-account` - Account creation
_Data Sent_: The information needed to create a new account for a user.
_Data Validated_: Yes to ensure the sent data fits the JSON schema for user data. This prepares the data to be saved to the database.
_Data Returned_: Unsure. One option is to send back JSON data with a message of account creation success or failure. This should then trigger a redirect for the frontend to a login page. The other option is to implement some sort of 2FA authorization.

- [x] **POST** `/api/users/login` - Account login
_Data Sent_: The information needed to log into an account, notably a username and password.
_Data Validated_: No because this data is not being saved to the database.
_Data Returned_: A message of success or failure in the form of JSON data. If the login was successful, the frontend should trigger a redirect to the user profile page.

#### _Trips_
- [x] **POST** `/api/trips/fare-estimate` 
_Data Sent_: All the information from the trip fare estimate page. This will be used to create a fare estimate.
_Data Validated_: No because this data is not being saved to the database.
_Data Returned_: The same trip details that were sent but with a total trip cost added. The data will be returned in the form of JSON data.

- [x] **POST** `/api/trips/booking`
_Data Sent_: The same information sent to the endpoint `fare-estimate`. However, the difference is this endpoint signals to save the trip in the database.
_Data Validated_: Yes to ensure the sent data fits the JSON schema for trip data. This prepares the data to be saved to the database.
_Data Returned_: The same trip details that were sent but with an additional message of database save success or failure. The data will be returned in the form of JSON data.

<br>

ETA: Writing this again after changes were made to how the endpoints would work. The initial endpoints were created based on the use of  `Express.js` functioning as both the backend and for serving the frontend through static HTML files. However, the purpose of the _Module 6 Project_ is to implement just the backend of a MERN or MEAN stack web application. As a result, `Express.js` needs to only function as the backend with API routes solely for sending and retrieving data from the database.

Adding the routes listed in the original issue description since they might still be of use:

```
__GET__
- [ ] `/`
_Returns_: main site page with Hero section, header, and footer
- [ ] `/trip-calculator`
_Returns_: fare estimator page
- [ ] `/account-create`
_Returns_: page to create an account
- [ ] `/account-login`
_Returns_: login page for an account
- [ ] `/account-info`
_Returns_: profile page for an account, showing profile info (taken from DB)
- [ ] `/account-trip-history`
_Returns_: page showing trip history for logged in user; if no user is logged in, redirects to ‘/account-login’

__POST__
- [ ] `/trip-calculator`
_Data Sent_: details from the fare estimator page - pickup address, dropoff address
_Data Returned_: trip details
- [ ] `/account-create`
_Data Sent_: details needed to create the account
_Data Returned_: redirect to login page - GET ‘/account-login’
- [ ] `/account-info`
_Data Sent_: changes to the account info to update it
_Data Returned_: new account info or “refresh” of the GET ‘/account-info” route
```
